detailed_rationale:
Elgi Equipments is India's largest air-compressor manufacturer with a genuinely global footprint (manufacturing and distribution across India, North America, Europe, and Asia). FY26 revenue grew 12% YoY to Rs 3,950.7 cr, with profit before tax growing faster at 17% YoY -- some real operating leverage. Q4 sales grew a similar ~12% YoY (Rs 1,113 cr vs Rs 993 cr). Growth over the last three years (9.1% CAGR) has been more modest than the most recent year (12.5%), a mild but not alarming acceleration.

The international segments show a mixed but improving picture: North America saw sustained volume growth in the industrial air-compressor division, though a 1.2% tariff impact weighed on Q4 margins, and a shift from owned to leased property in North America has increased depreciation. Europe is described by management as stabilising post a cost-realignment programme, with breakeven-to-marginal profitability targeted -- a turnaround still in progress rather than delivered. India and North America are expected to remain the strongest growth regions going forward.

At a PE of ~43x, this is a rich valuation for a business growing revenue in the low-double-digits with a 1-year quant score (49.7) that is meaningfully weaker than its 3-year score (57.1) -- the multiple looks to be pricing a global-compounder premium and/or a successful Europe turnaround plus continued North America share gains, none of which is yet fully evident in the reported growth rate. This is a case where the valuation is ahead of the currently demonstrated growth, though nothing here points to a business-quality problem, just a demanding entry price.
recommendation_rationale: Already a quant-Hold, reinforced by the weaker 1-year score relative to the 3-year score; moderate, single-digit-to-low-teens growth against a ~43x multiple is a real valuation-versus-growth tension, but it is an ordinary richly-valued-quality-compounder situation rather than a data or methodology problem, so Hold (not escalation) is the appropriate call.
summary: Elgi Equipments is India's largest air-compressor manufacturer with a genuinely global manufacturing and distribution footprint. Revenue and profit are both growing at a moderate pace, with North America showing steady volume growth (despite some tariff-related margin pressure) and Europe still working through a turnaround toward breakeven. The stock trades at a rich valuation relative to its current growth rate. We rate this a Hold: a good, well-diversified business, but priced for more than the numbers currently show.
positive_para: Genuine global diversification (India, North America, Europe, Asia) reduces single-market dependence, with sustained volume growth in the North American industrial compressor business and a Europe turnaround that management describes as approaching breakeven. Profit growing faster than revenue (PBT +17% vs revenue +12% in FY26) shows some real operating leverage.
negative_para: At ~43x earnings, the valuation is demanding for a business growing revenue in the low double digits (12.5% most recent year, 9.1% 3-year CAGR), and the weaker 1-year quant score versus the 3-year score is a signal worth taking seriously. Tariff-related margin pressure in North America and an as-yet-incomplete Europe turnaround are real, unresolved execution risks.
reverse_dcf_judgment: A ~43x multiple on low-double-digit revenue growth implies the market is pricing a meaningfully better growth/margin outcome than currently demonstrated -- likely crediting successful execution of the Europe turnaround and continued North American share gains ahead of firm evidence. This reads as rich rather than fairly priced against the numbers reported so far.
